termsList: Library of Congress: SRU catalogue is keyless; the JSON API is limited to 20 requests/min and is answered with a browser challenge on this network — reported as blocked, not circumvented.
Internet Archive: full text is only indexed for open items with a public-domain or Creative Commons signal, or published before 1930; lending items are linked, never copied.

Dalhousie University Archives (OAI-PMH), The National Archives UK (Discovery), Harvard (LibraryCloud), Wikimedia Commons, Nova Scotia Open Data, DPLA, Europeana: official APIs only, identified User-Agent, at most one request per second, pages cached. Wikimedia Commons and Dalhousie results are kept only when the record itself names the query topic.
Open Library and Nominatim: identified User-Agent, at most one request per second, cached.

Halifax Public Libraries, Nova Scotia Archives, MemoryNS, Beaton Institute, Acadia digital archives, Library and Archives Canada: link-only (bot challenge pages or no public API). No scraping; ingestion waits for partner exports.
sources.gapsLede: What people looked for, where nothing came back, and where the guide abstained. Only the query text is kept; no user data.
